item.title: Medi-Cal cuts could push seniors and people with disabilities off of coverage
item.description: Julia Feinberg feels like she’s living in a sinister version of Groundhog Day. For the second year in a row California lawmakers have made it tougher for seniors and people with disabilities to qualify for state-funded health benefits.
